title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/sos_resource.c:94 sos_resource_activate does not check incoming sequence against stored value, defeating the replay protection claimed in sos_resource_reset comments (lines 177-180). After a cancel preserves seq=N, an attacker can replay an old activation with seq=M where M<N, and it will succeed since only state (IDLE) is checked, not sequence.
close_reason: Fixed by wave-fix: added sequence replay check in sos_resource_activate to ensure seq > stored sequence
